vectors.name: same-1-buyer-v1
vectors.description: The buyer's copy: v1 envelope, network alias 'base', checksummed addresses.

vectors.name: same-1-seller-v2
vectors.description: The seller's copy of the SAME payment: v2 envelope, CAIP-2 network, lowercase addresses. Same fingerprint.

vectors.name: same-1-malleated-signature
vectors.description: The same authorization carried with the malleated signature (r, n-s, v flipped) -- both verify. Same fingerprint; a recipe that hashes the signature splits here.

vectors.name: same-1-reordered-keys
vectors.description: The same payment with every object's keys in a different order. Same fingerprint.

vectors.name: diff-2-other-nonce
vectors.description: A second payment from the same buyer, same amount, new nonce. Different fingerprint (a repeat purchase is not a duplicate).

vectors.name: diff-3-other-value
vectors.description: Same nonce, different value: a record describing a different amount must not join.

vectors.name: diff-4-other-network
vectors.description: Same authorization on Base Sepolia: a testnet payment never joins a mainnet record.

vectors.name: diff-7-max-value
vectors.description: value 2^256-1, the largest uint256: accepted and fingerprinted (the uint256 bound is inclusive).

vectors.name: diff-8-uppercase-nonce
vectors.description: A nonce written in uppercase hex: accepted, and the preimage holds it lowercased, so it fingerprints like the lowercase spelling.

vectors.name: diff-9-reference-32-chars
vectors.description: A CAIP-2 reference of exactly 32 characters: accepted (CAIP-2 allows 1-32, the bound is inclusive).

vectors.name: bad-value-number
vectors.description: value as a JSON number: parsers differ on large integers, so the recipe only accepts the decimal string.

vectors.name: bad-value-leading-zero
vectors.description: value '010000': two spellings of one amount would hash differently, so non-canonical decimals are refused.

vectors.name: bad-network-unknown-alias
vectors.description: An alias with no CAIP-2 mapping is refused rather than guessed.

vectors.name: bad-nonce-short
vectors.description: EIP-3009 nonces are bytes32.

vectors.name: bad-value-trailing-newline
vectors.description: A trailing newline on value must not be silently accepted (it would otherwise hash as a distinct, valid fingerprint).

vectors.name: bad-nonce-trailing-newline
vectors.description: Same class of bug on nonce: a trailing newline must be refused, not hashed as a different fingerprint.

vectors.name: bad-scheme-not-exact
vectors.description: scheme='upto' is Permit2-only on EVM (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization is not supported for it); it must not fingerprint as if it were 'exact'.

vectors.name: bad-value-exceeds-uint256
vectors.description: value one past uint256 max: ERC-3009 value is a uint256, so a larger canonical-looking decimal string must be refused, not hashed.

vectors.name: bad-scheme-missing
vectors.description: Envelope with no scheme at all: refused as scheme_not_exact (only an explicit 'exact' fingerprints), not as an unreadable envelope. Pins the condition name raised by Noûs (x402-foundation/tsc#4, 2026-10-06).

vectors.name: bad-address-trailing-newline
vectors.description: authorization.from plus a final newline: refused, not lowercased and hashed as a different payment.

vectors.name: bad-network-chain-zero
vectors.description: eip155:0: the chain-id reference must start with 1-9, so chain id 0 is refused.

vectors.name: bad-network-reference-too-long
vectors.description: A CAIP-2 reference of 33 characters: CAIP-2 allows 1-32.

vectors.name: bad-network-trailing-newline
vectors.description: network 'eip155:8453' plus a final newline: refused, neither stripped to Base nor hashed as another chain.

vectors.name: bad-network-number
vectors.description: network as a JSON number: refused with the network condition, not looked up and not an unreadable envelope.

vectors.name: bad-network-not-eip155
vectors.description: A CAIP-2 id outside the eip155 namespace with a numeric reference: the recipe is EVM only.

vectors.name: bad-network-hex-reference
vectors.description: eip155:0x2105 (Base's chain id in hex, as EIP-1193 wallets report it): the CAIP-2 reference is decimal.

vectors.name: bad-network-alias-uppercase
vectors.description: 'Base': the alias table is matched exactly, so a differently-cased alias is refused rather than guessed.

vectors.name: bad-asset-41-hex
vectors.description: asset with 41 hex digits: addresses are 20 bytes.

vectors.name: bad-address-39-hex
vectors.description: authorization.from with 39 hex digits.

vectors.name: bad-address-uppercase-prefix
vectors.description: authorization.to with the prefix '0X': the prefix is '0x'.

vectors.name: bad-address-no-prefix
vectors.description: authorization.to as 40 hex digits without '0x'.

vectors.name: bad-address-leading-space
vectors.description: authorization.from with a leading space: refused, like the trailing newline (an end-anchored-only check would accept it).

vectors.name: bad-nonce-63-hex
vectors.description: nonce with 63 hex digits.

vectors.name: bad-nonce-65-hex
vectors.description: nonce with 65 hex digits.

vectors.name: bad-nonce-uppercase-prefix
vectors.description: nonce with the prefix '0X': the prefix is '0x' (only the hex digits may be uppercase).

vectors.name: bad-value-negative
vectors.description: value '-1': uint256 has no sign.

vectors.name: bad-value-79-digits
vectors.description: value 10^78, 79 digits: past uint256 max by length alone.

vectors.name: bad-value-5000-digits
vectors.description: value of 5000 digits: refused by length before int(), which by default refuses to parse more than 4300 digits.

vectors.name: bad-scheme-uppercase
vectors.description: scheme 'EXACT': the scheme name is matched exactly.

vectors.name: bad-scheme-trailing-newline
vectors.description: scheme 'exact' plus a final newline: matched exactly, not stripped.

vectors.name: bad-authorization-not-object
vectors.description: authorization is a string, not an object: refused with the recipe's own condition.

vectors.name: bad-authorization-missing-from
vectors.description: authorization without from: refused with the from condition, not as an unreadable envelope (the bad-scheme-missing rule, applied to the authorization fields).

vectors.name: bad-authorization-missing-to
vectors.description: authorization without to: refused with the to condition.

vectors.name: bad-authorization-missing-value
vectors.description: authorization without value: refused with the value condition (a missing value is not 0).

vectors.name: bad-authorization-missing-nonce
vectors.description: authorization without nonce: refused with the nonce condition.

vectors.name: bad-address-non-hex
vectors.description: authorization.from with a non-hex character ('g') in place of a hex digit: the alphabet is 0-9a-fA-F.

vectors.name: bad-nonce-non-hex
vectors.description: nonce with a non-hex character ('g') in place of a hex digit.

vectors.name: bad-nonce-no-prefix
vectors.description: nonce as 64 hex digits without '0x'.

vectors.name: bad-nonce-number
vectors.description: nonce as a JSON number: refused with the nonce condition, not an unreadable envelope.

vectors.name: bad-value-unicode-digits
vectors.description: value '1' followed by four Arabic-Indic zeros (U+0660): refused; a Unicode-aware digit class (Python's \d) or int() alone would read it as 10000.

vectors.name: bad-value-underscore
vectors.description: value '10_000': refused; int() alone would accept the underscore.

vectors.name: bad-network-unicode-digits
vectors.description: eip155:8 followed by Arabic-Indic digits (U+0664 U+0665 U+0663, '8453' in mixed scripts): the CAIP-2 reference is ASCII; a Unicode-aware digit class would accept it.

vectors.name: bad-network-namespace-uppercase
vectors.description: 'EIP155:8453': the CAIP-2 namespace is lowercase and matched exactly.

vectors.name: alias-ts-only-abstract
vectors.description: A payment on Abstract, a v1 TS-only alias not in the old 8-entry table. Pins the normative table resolution of the group's open network-alias question (x402-foundation/tsc#4).

vectors.name: alias-go-only-celo
vectors.description: A payment on Celo, a v1 Go-only alias (absent from the TS NetworkSchema) not in the old 8-entry table. Same normative-table resolution.

naive_recipe_note: sha256 over the JSON each party holds gives 4 different digests for the 4 copies of payment P1; the recipe gives 1.
